mechanism: Betamethasone may increase nortriptyline metabolism via CYP450 enzyme induction while corticosteroids increase CNS side effects and psychiatric symptoms; nortriptyline may increase corticosteroid side effects.
action: Monitor for reduced nortriptyline efficacy and increased psychiatric symptoms; consider dose adjustment of nortriptyline if needed; monitor for corticosteroid-related adverse effects including hyperglycemia, hypertension, and mood changes.
